Body.Content:
Choose whether to track email opens separately from other tracking in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys. A dedicated consent purpose lets you omit tracking pixels from new emails while link clicks, website interactions, UTM parameters, and form prefill continue to follow their existing tracking consent settings.

GA date: February CY2027
